svg.title: HealthyCropping
svg.desc: HealthyCropping, offline crop disease diagnosis for coffee, cacao and banana in Costa Rica. The full content of this card is repeated as text below it.
svg.text: Coffee · cacao · banana, on the phone.
Five steps, four of them offline
If confidence is under the crop's calibrated threshold, the app
asks for a new photo instead of guessing.
Coffee's macro-F1 (0.72) is under the 0.80 target: rare classes
have about 20 test leaves each. The analysis is in EXPERIMENTS.md.
Every scan ends in one of four stamps
Next season: plot maps, disease hotspots and weather risk alerts (v1.1),
then satellite NDVI and one more Costa Rican crop (v1.2).
THE PHONE NEVER TALKS TO FIRESTORE · RULES DENY ALL CLIENTS
Trained on RoCoLe, BRACOL, CocoaMoniliaDataSet, UNAB cacao,
NM-AIST banana leaves and BananaLSD, under their own licences.
MIT code · free APK on GitHub Releases · no ads
